subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) The Padma Bridge carries i. has connected the capital with i. started in December 2014 (b) The construction work of ii. the entire project is being ii. 25 June 2022 (c) It was finally implemented with iii. the country’s own funds (d) It is important to note that iii. a four-lane highway on the iv. 21 south-western districts (e) The bridge upper level and v. a single track railway on the iv. the long-awaited Padma Bridge lower level v. inaugurated on
guide_solution: Matching (a) The Padma Bridge carries a four-lane highway on the upper level and a single track railway on the lower level. (b) The construction work of the long-awaited Padma Bridge started in December 2014. (c) It was finally inaugurated on 25 June 2022. (d) It is important to note that the entire project is being implemented with the country’s own funds. (e) The bridge has connected the capital with 21 south-western districts.
